title: Air/LCL Control Tower Specialist
jobDescription:
The Control Tower team member will be responsible. The role focuses on providing end-to-end visibility, driving continuous improvement, enhancing customer experience, and implementing automation and digital solutions to improve data quality and service delivery. At Maersk, we are a global leader in integrated logistics, pioneering the industry for over a century. Our commitment to innovation and transformation continuously redefines the boundaries of what’s possible—setting new benchmarks for efficiency, sustainability, and excellence. We believe in the power of diversity, collaboration, and continuous learning, and strive to ensure our people reflect the customers we proudly serve. With a workforce of over 100,000 employees across 130 countries, we work together to shape the future of global trade. Join us as we leverage cutting-edge technologies and create global opportunities. Let’s sail together towards a brighter, more sustainable future with Maersk. Purpose of the role The Control Tower team member will be responsible. The role focuses on providing end-to-end visibility, driving continuous improvement, enhancing customer experience, and implementing automation and digital solutions to improve data quality and service delivery. You will be Responsible for Providing the right level of visibility to customers and internal/external stakeholders by ensuring effective shipment tracking, proactive delay monitoring, and governance across Maersk service offerings. Tracking and tracing shipment milestones throughout the entire shipment lifecycle to ensure timely updates and operational transparency. Monitoring shipments proactively and identifying shipments at risk by issuing predictive service alerts to relevant internal stakeholders. Preparing customer reports, including Weekly Business Reviews (WBR), Monthly Business Reviews (MBR), Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR), and other business review reports. Preparing invoicing reports in accordance with customer-specific formats and business requirements. Maintaining data quality, accuracy, and integrity to support customer reporting, operational governance, and business decision-making. Handling customer queries and operational concerns received through dedicated email channels and hotline support, ensuring timely and effective resolution. Reviewing end-to-end operational processes to identify shipment delays, collaborating with business teams to implement corrective actions and process improvements. Aligning with business teams to conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring service issues and developing action plans to improve operational performance and customer experience. Qualifications Excellent communication skills. Strong stakeholder management skills. Min 3-5 years of experience in LCL forwarding business. Strong Data analytics skills, experience with coding will be added advantage. Excellent communication skills. Strong stakeholder management. Hands-on Control Tower operational experience. title: Site Lead
jobDescription:
APM Terminals Job Summary We are looking for an experienced logistics professional to lead end-to-end 4PL operations in an OEM environment. The role is responsible for managing domestic transportation, warehousing, multimodal logistics, and EXIM operations while ensuring seamless JIT/JIS deliveries. The incumbent will drive operational excellence through network optimization, digital transformation, cost optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives. The role also requires strong stakeholder management, leadership of cross-functional teams, and the use of analytics to enhance service performance, governance, and supply chain efficiency. Job Location: Talegaon, Pune Roles and Responsibilities
1. End-to-End Logistics Operations Lead domestic transportation operations including milk runs, FTL/PTL/LTL movements, and multimodal logistics aligned with production schedules Ensure JIT/JIS adherence and seamless line feeding through close coordination with plant logistics Oversee cross-dock, consolidation hubs, and warehouse flows for optimal utilization and efficiency Drive exception management, TAT adherence, POD compliance, and damage control through RCA and corrective actions Manage EXIM operations end-to-end — customs clearance, documentation, freight coordination, and inland delivery Optimize mode mix (air/ocean/LCL) balancing cost vs urgency.
2. Stakeholder & Governance Management Act as the primary interface between client SCM, plant leadership, procurement, and finance Govern LSP/3PL ecosystem through structured performance reviews (daily/weekly/monthly/QBRs) Build executive-level relationships and position 4PL as a strategic partner
3. Operational Excellence & Transformation Drive continuous improvement roadmap (Kaizen) Lead network optimization initiatives (lane redesign, hub rationalization, carrier strategy) Champion digital transformation via TMS, WMS, visibility tools, and automation Implement SOPs, audit frameworks, and control towers for governance Drive cost reduction, service improvement, and resilience strategies
4. Team Leadership & Capability Building Lead and develop a cross-functional team across operations, EXIM, and analytics Build a high-performance culture focused on ownership, data, and accountability Drive talent development, succession planning, and capability building Ensure strong safety culture and HSSE compliance Coach teams on client handling, analytics, and decision-making
5. Maersk is a global leader in integrated logistics and have been industry pioneers for over a century. Through innovation and transformation, we are redefining the boundaries of possibility, continuously setting new standards for efficiency, sustainability, and excellence. Opportunity: Maersk provides ample opportunities for growth and development, both professionally and personally. Innovation: Join a forward-thinking team that embraces innovation and cutting-edge technologies. Global Exposure: Collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and gain exposure to international business practices. Work-Life Balance: We value work-life balance and offer flexible working arrangements to support our employees

RESPONSIBILITIES:
The Financial analyst is expected to provide insight and foresight that enables the Trade FBPs to create value for stakeholders. The Financial Analyst, through the operating system must maintain and contribute towards an effective performance management framework and have a detailed understanding of the financial numbers as well as solid business knowledge. Through this he/she must challenge and contribute to more data driven decisions. Responsible for supporting and engaging in business decision making for the Trades org, by providing value-add analysis, management reporting, deep dive analysis, performance management reporting and financial forecasts. Ownership over validation of Freight List updates. Support the trade FBPs with various adhoc analysis and contribute to the MPR, QPR and various memos to the senior leadership Lead smaller and contribute to larger initiatives and projects related to improving performance management analysis, processes as well as projects seeking to improve financial visibility Support preparation of business cases. •Co-ordinate with COE team to ensure timely and accurate update of all reports. Coordinate product specification revisions and deviations with suppliers as needed. Maintain system accuracy, including lead-time, pricing, supplier information, and purchase order data. Conduct searches for new suppliers, evaluate their capabilities, assess risks, and qualify them as necessary. Issue purchase orders to suppliers with accurate pricing, deadlines, and terms and conditions. Review requests for materials, parts, and services, and verify specifications with requesters. Collaborate with stakeholders, suppliers, and colleagues to ensure smooth procurement processes. Assist other departments in resolving discrepancies between purchase orders, delivered quantities, quality, and prices. Identify cost-saving opportunities and help achieve yearly cost reduction targets. Work cross-functionally within the organization and support other functions as needed. Stakeholder Management & Collaboration: Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment and effective communication. Act as a liaison between suppliers and internal teams to facilitate smooth procurement operations. Engage with stakeholders to understand their needs and provide timely updates on procurement activities. Foster a collaborative environment by working closely with cross-functional teams to achieve common goals. Business Continuity: Ensure continuity of supply by proactively managing supplier relationships and mitigating risks. Develop contingency plans to address potential supply chain disruptions and maintain business operations. Monitor market trends and supplier performance to anticipate and address any issues that may impact business continuity. This position is responsible for assigning and tracking loads in Trinium, coordinating pickup and drop-off appointments through terminal websites, and providing ongoing driver support.
